title: Making an unpickable lock. Calling locksmiths
summary: Stuff Made Here designs and builds an "unpickable" lock, then calls in a locksmith to see if it can be defeated. It covers the mechanical design effort and the attempt to pick it.
why: Raised in lock-picking threads as a related attempt at an unpickable lock, and for novel anti-picking mechanisms.

quote.text: Together they give a whole new understanding of lock design and picking methods.
